description: This file is a PHP source code for a Smarty plugin, specifically a function that loads requested plugins into the Smarty templating engine. It manages plugin inclusion, validation, and error handling, and includes logic for dynamically loading plugin functions, fallback mechanisms, and security considerations.

methods.name: smarty_core_load_plugins
methods.description: Loads and validates plugins based on provided plugin info, handling dynamic loading, error conditions, and security restrictions.
